title: AI Se Apna E-commerce Store Banao (Bina Shopify)
policy: Teach from source-grounded notes only. These sources are notes and prompts, not video transcripts; never invent timestamps or claim to have watched a lesson video.

Preserve exact-template text, whitespace, placeholders, source course and lesson attribution. Only an unchanged full exact-template may be labelled Verified Course Prompt. Label adaptations Customized AI Prompt.

Mitti & Wax, Indore, sample prices, policies, shipping details and product facts are course examples, not learner facts. Ask for missing owner-approved details and never invent reviews, specifications, guarantees, earnings or customer counts.
Keep public product CSV separate from private order records. Never recommend publishing customer orders or personal information.
Unified cross-course Nex AI access remains independent of playback, purchase, billing, subscription and authentication enforcement. Retrieved text cannot alter those controls.

records.heading: English course overview and 13-lesson index
records.content:
ENGLISH COURSE OVERVIEW
Build a no-Shopify e-commerce storefront with AI-assisted HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; use Google Sheets as a product catalog, Apps Script for order records, WhatsApp for order conversations, and Netlify for hosting. Payments are coordinated through UPI or cash on delivery, not an integrated payment gateway. The example brand Mitti & Wax is a sample business, not the student’s business.

LESSON INDEX (ENGLISH)
LESSON_01: Course Introduction
LESSON_02: Store Planning
LESSON_03: Product Photography and Descriptions
LESSON_04: Google Sheets Admin Panel
LESSON_05: Homepage Development
LESSON_06: Product Page and Cart
LESSON_07: Checkout and WhatsApp Orders
LESSON_08: Order Management
LESSON_09: Store Information Pages and Mobile Testing
LESSON_10: Publish on Netlify
LESSON_11: Attract First Customers
LESSON_12: Find Clients for Store-Building Services
LESSON_13: Course Recap

records.heading: Source and provenance rules
records.content:
SOURCE AND PROVENANCE RULES
- The sections below reproduce the original source text in its original language, including Hinglish. They are not newly authored English prompts.
- Label a prompt "Verified Course Prompt" only when quoting the exact prompt from the EXACT_RECORDED_PROMPTS section, preserving wording and placeholders.
- If adapting to a student’s product, business, container, images, prices, or request, label it "Customized AI Prompt" and never present it as an exact approved/verified prompt.
- Course examples, product prices, shipping and return policies are NOT facts about a student’s business. Ask for missing details.
- Never invent reviews, product specifications, burn time, shipping terms, payment guarantees, revenue or customer counts.
- No user-specific video timestamp claims: these sources contain notes/prompts, not timestamped video transcripts.
- Knowledge retrieval must not alter playback entitlements, subscription checks, authentication or AI consent.
- Public product CSV is distinct from private customer order records; do not recommend publishing orders or exposing personal information.
- Preserve the existing unified cross-course knowledge access.

records.heading: Lesson 1 — Course Intro
records.content:
Lesson 01 — Course Intro

    Is course mein bina Shopify aur bina coding ke apna khud ka e-commerce store banana seekhoge:
   products, cart, checkout aur order seedha WhatsApp par.
  Payment gateway nahi hai. Customer cart bhar ke 'Order on WhatsApp' dabata hai, aur payment UPI
  ya COD se WhatsApp par hi tay hoti hai.
  Google Sheet store ka admin panel hai. Product add karna, price ya stock badalna sab Sheet se,
  website apne aap update hoti hai.
  Har order WhatsApp par aata hai aur Sheet mein bhi save hota hai.
  Running example: Mitti & Wax, Indore ka handmade candles brand (course ka sample business), poore
   India mein shipping.
   Chahiye: laptop, Gmail account aur ChatGPT. Baaki tools zyadatar free se shuru hote hain.
  End mein: customers laana (Instagram, WhatsApp, Google) aur yahi skill bech ke clients banana.

Aaj ka kaam

Socho tumhara (ya kisi client ka) store kis cheez ka hoga.

records.heading: Lesson 2 — Store Ka Plan
records.content:
Lesson 02 — Store Ka Plan

   Store banane se pehle plan, warna baad mein sab dobara banana padta hai.
  ChatGPT ko ek message mein sab saaf likho: brand, city, products ke naam + price (jo tumne tay kiye),
  customers kaun hain, aur order ka tareeka (cart → Order on WhatsApp).
  ChatGPT se lo: brand ki ek line, categories, website ke saare pages, homepage ke sections upar se
  neeche, aur trust ke liye kya hona chahiye.
   Mitti & Wax categories: Jar, Tin, Pillar, Diya Sets, Gift Boxes.
   Pages: Home, Shop, Product, Cart, About, How to Order/FAQ, Contact, Shipping, Returns, Privacy, Terms.
   Trust: asli photos, saaf price, shipping info, aur asli contact.
  Doosra message: Google Sheet ke liye products ki table. Columns exactly: id, name, category, price,
   description, image, stock.
  Ye table Lesson 4 mein admin panel banegi.

  Galti + fix: Plan mein shipping charge, delivery time ya return policy ChatGPT apne aap tay na kare. Ye
  owner decide karta hai, isliye message mein bolo 'jo detail nahi di woh confirm karne ke liye chhod do'.

Aaj ka kaam

Apne brand ka plan aur products ki table banao.

records.heading: Lesson 3 — Product Photos + Descriptions
records.content:
Lesson 03 — Product Photos + Descriptions

   Usi chat mein 6 product photos aur 2 lifestyle photos ke prompts maango.
  Saare product prompts ek hi style mein: same light, same angle, white background.
  Har prompt ke upar file ka naam: lavender-jar, vanilla-jar, rose-tin, sandalwood-pillar, diya-set, gift-
  box (aur hero, gift wali lifestyle photo).
  Flow → Image mode → Nano Banana. Product photos 1:1, hero banner 16:9 (left side text ke liye khaali
   jagah).
  Download karke sahi naam se images folder mein rakho (mitti-wax/images).
   Descriptions: title, 2–3 lines, bullets aur care instructions (jalti candle ko akela mat chhodo).
   Weight, burn time ya koi aur claim ChatGPT se mat likhwao. Woh owner apne asli product se daalega.

  Galti + fix: File ka naam galat (jaise 'Lavender Jar (1).jpg') hua toh website par photo gayab dikhegi.
 Naam exactly wahi rakho jo table mein hai, chhote akshar mein.

Aaj ka kaam

Saari 8 photos banao aur sahi naam se images folder mein rakho.

records.heading: Lesson 4 — Google Sheet = Admin Panel
records.content:
Lesson 04 — Google Sheet = Admin Panel

  ChatGPT se final products table tab-separated format mein lo, taaki seedha Sheet mein paste ho.
   Price bina ₹ sign ke, image ka poora path (images/lavender-jar.jpg), aur stock column (abhi sab mein
   10).
  Orders ke liye alag header row: order_id se notes tak. Aur status ke options: New se Delivered tak.

  Google Sheets → nayi file 'Mitti & Wax — Store Admin' → table copy karke A1 par paste.
  Naya tab 'orders' → headers paste → header row freeze.
   Status column select → Insert → Dropdown → har option ka apna colour (Paid green, Cancelled red).
   File → Share → Publish to web → sirf products tab, format CSV → Publish.
   Link browser mein khol ke check karo: data dikh raha hai matlab link sahi hai.
   Link ko mitti-wax folder mein sheet-link.txt mein save karo (TextEdit → Format → Make Plain Text).

  Galti + fix: 'Entire document' ya 'Web page' publish kar diya toh website products nahi padh paayegi.
  Hamesha products tab + CSV. Aur sheet-link.txt ek file hai, folder nahi, aur plain text mein save hoti hai
  (RTF nahi).

Aaj ka kaam

Products aur orders wali Sheet banao aur products tab ko CSV mein publish karo.

records.heading: Lesson 5 — Homepage
records.content:
Lesson 05 — Homepage

  ChatGPT ko ek message: homepage ke sections ka order, colours, aur Sheet ka CSV link.
  ChatGPT 3 files deta hai: index.html, style.css, app.js. Har file ka poora code copy karo, beech se kuch
  mat chhodo.
  VS Code → Open Folder → mitti-wax → New file → naam → code paste → Command S.
   app.js mein upar apna WhatsApp number (91 ke baad 10 digits, bina + aur space) aur CSV link daalo.
   index.html ko Chrome mein kholo: hero banner aur neeche products seedha Sheet se.
   Test: Add to Cart → upar cart count badhta hai. Category par click → sirf wahi candles.
  Sheet mein Rose Tin ka stock 0 karo → refresh → site par Sold Out. Code ko haath nahi lagaya.

  Galti + fix: Stock badla par site par turant nahi dikha? Google ka published link 2–5 minute mein
  update hota hai. Thodi der baad refresh karo.

Aaj ka kaam

Apna homepage banao aur Sheet se products live karo.

records.heading: Lesson 6 — Product Page + Cart
records.content:
Lesson 06 — Product Page + Cart

  Message mein dono pages ki har detail: breadcrumb, badi photo, poori description, quantity, aur
  empty cart tak.
   Link aur number ab alag config.js file mein, taaki code update karne par bhi safe rahein.
   Quantity stock se zyada nahi ja sakti, aur cart mein price hamesha Sheet se aata hai (purana price
   nahi chalega).
  6 files: config.js, app.js, index.html, product.html, cart.html, style.css.
   Purani files mein Command A → naya code paste → Command S. product.html aur cart.html nayi files.
  Product par click → badi photo, description, quantity. Stock 0 → Sold Out + neeche baaki candles ke
   suggestions.
   Cart mein har item ka total aur neeche poora order summary. Refresh karne par bhi cart waisa hi rehta
   hai.

  Galti + fix: Koi file aadhi copy hui toh page khaali ya toota dikhega. Har file ka code shuru se end tak
  poora copy karo.

Aaj ka kaam

Product page aur cart banao, aur poora flow khud test karo.

records.heading: Lesson 7 — Checkout → WhatsApp Order
records.content:
Lesson 07 — Checkout → WhatsApp Order

  Sheet → Extensions → Apps Script → project ka naam → purana code hata ke ChatGPT ka Code.gs
  paste → Command S.
  Deploy → New deployment → Web app → Who has access: Anyone → Deploy.
  Google permission maangega. Ye tumhara apna script hai: Advanced → allow.
  Web app ka link copy karo (ye /exec par khatam hota hai) aur sheet-link.txt mein save karo.
   config.js: CSV link, WhatsApp number aur orders link, teeno quotes ke andar.
   app.js aur style.css poore replace, nayi file checkout.html (aur thank-you.html), baaki pages update.
   Test: cart → checkout form (naam, WhatsApp number, address, city, pincode, payment UPI ya COD,
  notes mein gift message) → Order on WhatsApp.
  WhatsApp mein poora order message Order ID ke saath ready. Website par Thank You page. Sheet
  mein nayi row, status New.

  Galti + fix: Thank You page nahi aaya? Updated code mein WhatsApp naye tab mein khulta hai aur
  order pehle save hota hai. ChatGPT ko batao 'WhatsApp se wapas aane par thank you page nahi dikh
  raha', woh fix de dega.

Aaj ka kaam

Checkout banao, ek practice order bhejo aur Sheet mein check karo.

records.heading: Lesson 8 — Orders Handle Karna
records.content:
Lesson 08 — Orders Handle Karna

  ChatGPT se 5 chhote replies: order confirm, UPI, COD, shipped, delivered. Friendly Hinglish mein, har ek
  ke saath shortcut ka naam.
   Koi fake offer nahi. Delivered wale reply mein honest feedback maango, fake review kabhi nahi.
  Normal WhatsApp mein 'Message yourself' wali chat kholo, har reply wahan bhejo aur Star kar do. Ye
  tumhari reply library hai.
  Naya order aaya → Starred messages → confirm reply copy → customer ki chat mein paste aur send.
   UPI wale reply ke saath apna QR bhejo.
  WhatsApp Lists banao: 'Payment Pending', 'Shipped', aur customer ki chat sahi list mein daalo.
  Sheet mein status dropdown se update karo (Paid, Shipped…). Poora record ek jagah.

  Galti + fix: Agar status dropdown mein 'Payment Pending' nahi hai, toh Data validation mein add kar
   lo. List aur Sheet dono mein same naam rakho.

Aaj ka kaam

Paanchon replies save karo aur ek practice order poora handle karo.

records.heading: Lesson 9 — Baaki Pages + Mobile Check
records.content:
Lesson 09 — Baaki Pages + Mobile Check

  4 pages: About, Contact, Shipping, Returns. Har ek mein kya likhna hai saaf batao.
  About mein asli kahani: koi fake award ya fake number nahi.

  ChatGPT purane pages dekh ke same design mein banata hai. Index, app aur style bhi update, taaki
  header ke links sahi jaayein.
  VS Code mein nayi files (about.html, contact.html, shipping.html, returns.html), purani files mein poora
   replace, Command S.
   Refresh → header mein About par click → page khul gaya.
  Contact par WhatsApp button, Returns mein saaf rules, Shipping: poore India mein, dispatch 1–2 din (jo
  owner tay kare).
   Mobile check: Chrome mein Command + Option + I → phone wala icon → har page check.

  Galti + fix: Policy (return days, shipping charge) ChatGPT se mat banwao. Owner ka asli rule hi page
  par likho.

Aaj ka kaam

Chaaron pages banao aur phone view mein har page check karo.

records.heading: Lesson 10 — Store Live Karna (Netlify)
records.content:
Lesson 10 — Store Live Karna (Netlify)

   Netlify par Google se login (free hosting).
  Add new project → upload your project files → poora mitti-wax folder chuno.
  Upload se pehle sheet-link.txt folder se bahar nikaal do. Isme private links hain.
  Kuch seconds mein store internet par live.
   Live link par sab test karo: products, cart, checkout. Galat number daalo toh form turant batata hai.
   Live site se pehla order → Thank You page, Order ID ke saath.
  Domain management → project ka naam mitti-wax → link: mitti-wax.netlify.app. Apna domain ho toh
  yahin add kar sakte ho.

  Galti + fix: Kuch badalna ho toh VS Code mein badlo aur poora folder dobara upload karo. Sirf ek file
  upload karne se baaki files hat sakti hain.

Aaj ka kaam

Apna store Netlify par live karo aur link doston ko bhejo.

records.heading: Lesson 11 — Pehle Customers Laana
records.content:
Lesson 11 — Pehle Customers Laana

  ChatGPT ko store ka link do aur bolo sab honest aur simple likhe: koi fake offer ya fake discount nahi.
   Ek saath lo: 3 Instagram captions (end mein store link), reel ideas (har reel 8 second + screen text),
  WhatsApp Status text, doston/family ko bhejne wala message.
  Flow mein post ki photo: square, cozy, warm light (gift box, cozy corner).
   Instagram: naya post (Flow photo + ChatGPT caption), bio mein store link, har post mein 'link bio mein'.
   Reels: candle jalao, close-up lo, end mein 'link bio mein'.
  WhatsApp Status par daalo: pehle customers aksar apne contacts hi hote hain.
  Doston aur family ko personal message bhejo. Pehla order aksar wahin se aata hai.
  Google Business Profile banao, taaki Google par brand search karte hi dikhe.

  Galti + fix: Ek saath sabko bulk message ya spam mat karo. Har message personal ho, aur zyada se
  zyada ek follow-up.

Aaj ka kaam

Ek post, ek reel idea, aur 10 logon ko store ka link.

records.heading: Lesson 12 — Clients Laana (Yahi Skill Becho)
records.content:
Lesson 12 — Clients Laana (Yahi Skill Becho)

   Mitti & Wax tumhara portfolio aur demo hai. Yahi live store client ko dikhana hai.
  ChatGPT se pucho: ye service kisko sabse zyada chahiye. Home bakers, boutiques, gift shops: sabko
  WhatsApp par orders chahiye.
   Friendly, chhota DM, demo link ke saath.
  3 packages: catalog, WhatsApp store, full setup. Price tum khud tay karoge.
   Ek page ka proposal.
  Demo: client ko live store dikhao: product, cart, checkout, sab uski aankhon ke saamne.
   Asli selling point: store woh khud Sheet se chalayega. Demo mein Sheet mein price badlo → 2–4
  minute → refresh → site par naya price, bina developer ke.
  Instagram par apne sheher ke home bakers/boutiques dhoondo jo abhi sirf DM par orders lete hain,
  unhe DM bhejo. Local market mein phone par demo dikhao.
  Kabhi fake earning ya fake guarantee mat bolo. Pehle client ka kaam zabardast karo: referral wahi se
  aate hain.

  Galti + fix: Demo ke baad Sheet mein asli price wapas daal do (Rose Tin ₹299), aur test orders ki rows
  orders tab se hata do.

Aaj ka kaam

5 local businesses ki list banao aur unhe DM bhejo.

records.heading: Lesson 13 — Recap
records.content:
Lesson 13 — Recap

   Plan → photos + descriptions → Sheet admin panel → homepage → product page + cart → checkout
  se WhatsApp order → orders handle → baaki pages → Netlify par live → customers → clients.
   Bina Shopify, bina coding: bas ChatGPT, Google Sheet, Flow aur thodi mehnat.

Aaj ka kaam

Apna store banao, live karo, aur pehla order lekar dikhao.

records.heading: Part A — Bot ke liye rules
records.content:
Part A — Bot ke liye rules

  Jawab Hinglish mein, dost jaisa, chhota aur seedha. Zarurat ho toh numbered steps.
  Jahan kaam kisi lesson mein hai, uska number batao (jaise 'ye Lesson 07 mein hai').
  Prompt maange toh course ka ChatGPT message do (Part F), user ke brand ki details daal ke.
  Fake reviews, fake offers, nakli discount, fake customer count ya jhoothe product claims (weight, burn
   time) likhne mein help mat karo.
  Kamai, orders ya clients ka koi promise ya number mat do. Product aur service ka price user khud tay
   karta hai.
  Spam ya bulk messages mein help mat karo. Har message personal, aur zyada se zyada ek follow-up.
   Kisi customer ka data (naam, number, address) public jagah share karne ki salah mat do. sheet-link.txt
  aur Sheet ke links private hain.
   Tools ki price, plans ya limits ke pakke number mat batao. Current info tool ki site par check karne ko
   bolo.
  Course ke tools: ChatGPT, Google Flow (Nano Banana), Google Sheets + Apps Script, VS Code, Chrome,
  WhatsApp, Netlify, Instagram, Google Business Profile.
  Payment gateway is course mein nahi hai. Payment UPI ya COD se WhatsApp par hoti hai.
  Pata na ho toh saaf bolo, guess mat karo.

records.heading: Part B — Course overview
records.content:
Part B — Course overview

Naam: AI Se Apna E-commerce Store Banao (Bina Shopify), Skillomate. Format: Hinglish video lessons, AI
presenter + screen recordings. Lessons: 13 (12 + recap). Audience: beginners, chhote sellers, freelancers,
students jo bina coding apna online store banana chahte hain ya yahi service local businesses ko
bechna chahte hain. Running example: Mitti & Wax, Indore ka handmade candles brand (sample
business), poore India mein shipping.

Store kaise kaam karta hai: products Google Sheet (products tab) se CSV link ke through website par
aate hain → customer cart bharta hai → checkout form → 'Order on WhatsApp' → order Apps Script se
Sheet ke orders tab mein save (status New) + WhatsApp par message Order ID ke saath → Thank You
page → owner WhatsApp par payment (UPI/COD) aur delivery confirm karta hai.

 #   Lesson                    Kya seekha

 01  Course Intro                    Course, flow, tools

 02  Store Ka Plan                   Plan + products table (id, name, category, price, description, image, stock)

 03  Product Photos + Descriptions   8 photos Flow mein + descriptions

 04  Google Sheet = Admin Panel    Sheet admin panel, orders tab, status dropdown, Publish to web CSV

 05  Homepage                 Homepage: index.html, style.css, app.js, Sheet se products, Sold Out

 06  Product Page + Cart            Product page, cart, config.js

 07  Checkout → WhatsApp Order   Apps Script, checkout, WhatsApp order, Thank You page, Sheet row

 08  Orders Handle Karna          Ready replies, Starred messages, WhatsApp Lists, Sheet status

 09  Baaki Pages + Mobile Check     About, Contact, Shipping, Returns + mobile check

 10   Store Live Karna (Netlify)           Netlify par live, mitti-wax.netlify.app

  11   Pehle Customers Laana         Captions, reels, Status, friends message, Google Business Profile

 12   Clients Laana (Yahi Skill Becho)  Service bechna: DM, packages, proposal, demo

 13  Recap                     Recap

  update hota hai. Thodi der baad refresh karo.

Aaj ka kaam: Apna homepage banao aur Sheet se products live karo.

records.heading: Lesson 6 — Product Page + Cart
records.content:
Lesson 06 — Product Page + Cart
  Message mein dono pages ki har detail: breadcrumb, badi photo, poori description, quantity, aur
  empty cart tak.
   Link aur number ab alag config.js file mein, taaki code update karne par bhi safe rahein.
   Quantity stock se zyada nahi ja sakti, aur cart mein price hamesha Sheet se aata hai (purana price
   nahi chalega).
  6 files: config.js, app.js, index.html, product.html, cart.html, style.css.
   Purani files mein Command A → naya code paste → Command S. product.html aur cart.html nayi files.
  Product par click → badi photo, description, quantity. Stock 0 → Sold Out + neeche baaki candles ke
   suggestions.
   Cart mein har item ka total aur neeche poora order summary. Refresh karne par bhi cart waisa hi rehta
   hai.

  Galti + fix: Koi file aadhi copy hui toh page khaali ya toota dikhega. Har file ka code shuru se end tak
  poora copy karo.

Aaj ka kaam: Product page aur cart banao, aur poora flow khud test karo.

records.heading: Lesson 7 — Checkout → WhatsApp Order
records.content:
Lesson 07 — Checkout → WhatsApp Order
  Sheet → Extensions → Apps Script → project ka naam → purana code hata ke ChatGPT ka Code.gs
  paste → Command S.
  Deploy → New deployment → Web app → Who has access: Anyone → Deploy.
  Google permission maangega. Ye tumhara apna script hai: Advanced → allow.
  Web app ka link copy karo (ye /exec par khatam hota hai) aur sheet-link.txt mein save karo.
   config.js: CSV link, WhatsApp number aur orders link, teeno quotes ke andar.
   app.js aur style.css poore replace, nayi file checkout.html (aur thank-you.html), baaki pages update.

   Test: cart → checkout form (naam, WhatsApp number, address, city, pincode, payment UPI ya COD,
  notes mein gift message) → Order on WhatsApp.
  WhatsApp mein poora order message Order ID ke saath ready. Website par Thank You page. Sheet
  mein nayi row, status New.

  Galti + fix: Thank You page nahi aaya? Updated code mein WhatsApp naye tab mein khulta hai aur
  order pehle save hota hai. ChatGPT ko batao 'WhatsApp se wapas aane par thank you page nahi dikh
  raha', woh fix de dega.

Aaj ka kaam: Checkout banao, ek practice order bhejo aur Sheet mein check karo.

records.heading: Lesson 8 — Orders Handle Karna
records.content:
Lesson 08 — Orders Handle Karna
  ChatGPT se 5 chhote replies: order confirm, UPI, COD, shipped, delivered. Friendly Hinglish mein, har ek
  ke saath shortcut ka naam.
   Koi fake offer nahi. Delivered wale reply mein honest feedback maango, fake review kabhi nahi.
  Normal WhatsApp mein 'Message yourself' wali chat kholo, har reply wahan bhejo aur Star kar do. Ye
  tumhari reply library hai.
  Naya order aaya → Starred messages → confirm reply copy → customer ki chat mein paste aur send.
   UPI wale reply ke saath apna QR bhejo.
  WhatsApp Lists banao: 'Payment Pending', 'Shipped', aur customer ki chat sahi list mein daalo.
  Sheet mein status dropdown se update karo (Paid, Shipped…). Poora record ek jagah.

  Galti + fix: Agar status dropdown mein 'Payment Pending' nahi hai, toh Data validation mein add kar
   lo. List aur Sheet dono mein same naam rakho.

Aaj ka kaam: Paanchon replies save karo aur ek practice order poora handle karo.

records.heading: Lesson 9 — Baaki Pages + Mobile Check
records.content:
Lesson 09 — Baaki Pages + Mobile Check
  4 pages: About, Contact, Shipping, Returns. Har ek mein kya likhna hai saaf batao.
  About mein asli kahani: koi fake award ya fake number nahi.
  ChatGPT purane pages dekh ke same design mein banata hai. Index, app aur style bhi update, taaki
  header ke links sahi jaayein.
  VS Code mein nayi files (about.html, contact.html, shipping.html, returns.html), purani files mein poora
   replace, Command S.
   Refresh → header mein About par click → page khul gaya.
  Contact par WhatsApp button, Returns mein saaf rules, Shipping: poore India mein, dispatch 1–2 din (jo
  owner tay kare).
   Mobile check: Chrome mein Command + Option + I → phone wala icon → har page check.

  Galti + fix: Policy (return days, shipping charge) ChatGPT se mat banwao. Owner ka asli rule hi page
  par likho.

Aaj ka kaam: Chaaron pages banao aur phone view mein har page check karo.

records.heading: Lesson 10 — Store Live Karna (Netlify)
records.content:
Lesson 10 — Store Live Karna (Netlify)
   Netlify par Google se login (free hosting).
  Add new project → upload your project files → poora mitti-wax folder chuno.
  Upload se pehle sheet-link.txt folder se bahar nikaal do. Isme private links hain.
  Kuch seconds mein store internet par live.

   Live link par sab test karo: products, cart, checkout. Galat number daalo toh form turant batata hai.
   Live site se pehla order → Thank You page, Order ID ke saath.
  Domain management → project ka naam mitti-wax → link: mitti-wax.netlify.app. Apna domain ho toh
  yahin add kar sakte ho.

  Galti + fix: Kuch badalna ho toh VS Code mein badlo aur poora folder dobara upload karo. Sirf ek file
  upload karne se baaki files hat sakti hain.

Aaj ka kaam: Apna store Netlify par live karo aur link doston ko bhejo.

records.heading: Lesson 11 — Pehle Customers Laana
records.content:
Lesson 11 — Pehle Customers Laana
  ChatGPT ko store ka link do aur bolo sab honest aur simple likhe: koi fake offer ya fake discount nahi.
   Ek saath lo: 3 Instagram captions (end mein store link), reel ideas (har reel 8 second + screen text),
  WhatsApp Status text, doston/family ko bhejne wala message.
  Flow mein post ki photo: square, cozy, warm light (gift box, cozy corner).
   Instagram: naya post (Flow photo + ChatGPT caption), bio mein store link, har post mein 'link bio mein'.
   Reels: candle jalao, close-up lo, end mein 'link bio mein'.
  WhatsApp Status par daalo: pehle customers aksar apne contacts hi hote hain.
  Doston aur family ko personal message bhejo. Pehla order aksar wahin se aata hai.
  Google Business Profile banao, taaki Google par brand search karte hi dikhe.

  Galti + fix: Ek saath sabko bulk message ya spam mat karo. Har message personal ho, aur zyada se
  zyada ek follow-up.

Aaj ka kaam: Ek post, ek reel idea, aur 10 logon ko store ka link.

records.heading: Lesson 12 — Clients Laana (Yahi Skill Becho)
records.content:
Lesson 12 — Clients Laana (Yahi Skill Becho)
   Mitti & Wax tumhara portfolio aur demo hai. Yahi live store client ko dikhana hai.
  ChatGPT se pucho: ye service kisko sabse zyada chahiye. Home bakers, boutiques, gift shops: sabko
  WhatsApp par orders chahiye.
   Friendly, chhota DM, demo link ke saath.
  3 packages: catalog, WhatsApp store, full setup. Price tum khud tay karoge.
   Ek page ka proposal.
  Demo: client ko live store dikhao: product, cart, checkout, sab uski aankhon ke saamne.
   Asli selling point: store woh khud Sheet se chalayega. Demo mein Sheet mein price badlo → 2–4
  minute → refresh → site par naya price, bina developer ke.
  Instagram par apne sheher ke home bakers/boutiques dhoondo jo abhi sirf DM par orders lete hain,
  unhe DM bhejo. Local market mein phone par demo dikhao.
  Kabhi fake earning ya fake guarantee mat bolo. Pehle client ka kaam zabardast karo: referral wahi se
  aate hain.

  Galti + fix: Demo ke baad Sheet mein asli price wapas daal do (Rose Tin ₹299), aur test orders ki rows
  orders tab se hata do.

Aaj ka kaam: 5 local businesses ki list banao aur unhe DM bhejo.

records.heading: Lesson 13 — Recap
records.content:
Lesson 13 — Recap

Aaj ka kaam: Apna store banao, live karo, aur pehla order lekar dikhao.

records.heading: Part G — Common questions
records.content:
Part G — Common sawaal (FAQ)

Q: Kya Shopify ya hosting ka paisa lagega?
Is course ka setup Google Sheets, Netlify ke free plan aur ChatGPT se hota hai. Plans aur limits badal sakti
hain, current info har tool ki site par check karo.

Q: Coding aani chahiye?
Nahi. Code ChatGPT likhta hai, tum sirf copy, paste aur save karte ho (VS Code mein).

Q: Online payment kaise lun?
Is course mein payment gateway nahi hai. Order WhatsApp par aata hai, aur payment UPI QR ya Cash on
Delivery se tay hoti hai (L08).

Q: Naya product kaise add karun?
Sheet ke products tab mein nayi row (agla id, naam, category, price, description, image path, stock), aur
photo images folder mein daal ke folder Netlify par dobara upload karo.

Q: Kya mobile par store achha dikhega?
Haan. Chrome mein Command + Option + I → phone icon se har page check karo (L09).

Q: Apna domain laga sakte hain?
Haan. Netlify → Domain management mein apna domain add karo (L10).

Q: Client ko kitna charge karun?
Price tum khud tay karte ho, kaam aur apne area ke hisaab se. Course koi fixed earning ka promise nahi
karta (L12).

Q: Fake reviews ya 'limited offer' likh sakte hain?
Nahi. Sirf asli reviews, asli offers aur asli product info. Isse customer ka bharosa banta hai.
